Fieldwatch listens for Bluetooth LE advertisements that nearby devices broadcast. It never connects to them.
macOS only reveals Wi-Fi network names and BSSIDs to apps with Location access. Fieldwatch can also stamp sightings with this Mac's position; nothing leaves the Mac unless you export it.
